mentions.name: FlightWise
mentions.description: An all-in-one SaaS platform for flight school operations that handles aircraft fleet management, scheduling, and student course progress tracking. Built from the real-world experience of running a flight school and now offered publicly to other flight schools.
mentions.problem: Flight school day-to-day operations are challenging, and existing software is often outdated and expensive, offering poor value for its high cost.
mentions.audience: Flight schools, from students to administrative staff.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building FlightWise (https://flightwise.io), an all-in-one SaaS platform for flight school operations.

evidence.value: I'm building FlightWise (https://flightwise.io), an all-in-one SaaS platform for flight school operations.
